description: This file defines the OptionsChainsProperties class, which extends Data, providing methods and properties for analyzing options chain data, including calculations for greeks, implied volatility, strike prices, expiration dates, and strategies like straddle and strangle.

classes.name: OptionsChainsProperties
classes.description: Base class for handling options chain data, providing properties and methods for analysis and strategy calculations.

methods.name: last_price
methods.description: Get or set the manually specified underlying asset price.

methods.name: dataframe
methods.description: Returns all options chain data as a pandas DataFrame, with computed columns like breakeven, DEX, GEX.

methods.name: expirations
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of unique expiration dates.

methods.name: strikes
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of unique strike prices.

methods.name: has_iv
methods.description: Indicates if implied volatility data is present.

methods.name: has_greeks
methods.description: Indicates if greeks data (delta, gamma, etc.) is present.

methods.name: total_oi
methods.description: Returns open interest statistics grouped by expiration and strike.

methods.name: total_volume
methods.description: Returns volume statistics grouped by expiration and strike.

methods.name: total_dex
methods.description: Returns total Delta Dollars (DEX) grouped by expiration and strike, requires greeks.

methods.name: total_gex
methods.description: Returns total Gamma Exposure (GEX) grouped by expiration and strike, requires greeks.

methods.name: _identify_price_col
methods.description: Identifies the correct bid or ask price column for options data, based on provider variations.

methods.name: filter_data
methods.description: Filters options data based on date, option type, moneyness, columns, and statistical metrics.

methods.name: _get_stat
methods.description: Calculates and returns statistical summaries (total, expiration, strike) for specified metrics.

methods.name: _get_nearest_expiration
methods.description: Finds the nearest expiration date to a given date or number of days.

methods.name: _get_nearest_otm_strikes
methods.description: Finds the nearest out-of-the-money call and put strikes at a specified percent OTM.

methods.name: _get_nearest_strike
methods.description: Finds the nearest strike price for a given option type, days to expiry, and target price.

methods.name: straddle
methods.description: Calculates the cost and payoff of a straddle options strategy for a given expiry and strike.

methods.name: strangle
methods.description: Calculates the cost and payoff of a strangle options strategy for a given expiry and moneyness.
